title: Preopen official disclosure capture and rolling-window falsification receipt

falsification: Absence from a later current snapshot cannot be interpreted as event cancellation or proof that no event existed.
A complete two-poll capture of one source lane proves bounded lane observation only, not completeness across all news/event lanes.
Displayed publication time still does not prove first API availability time.
No newly arriving row was observed between the two 67-second polls, so this run does not estimate first-arrival latency.
